name: Thermal Receipt
keywords: till receipt thermal paper pricing invoice shop
idea: Content prints out on a till roll: a narrow monospaced column, dashed dividers, a torn zigzag edge, a barcode, and a total that lands last.
note: Live: press "Print receipt" and the lines print one by one, ending with the total and a barcode.
borrowed: Thermal till receipts and order tickets: 58/80mm paper rolls, dot-matrix monospace, dashed separators, centred shop headers, item/price columns, barcodes, torn edges, the faded grey of thermal print.
mood: Honest, itemised, witty. Suits pricing pages, shops, "CV as a receipt", year-in-review and changelog pages. Monospace is earned here: it's what receipts are printed in.

type.meta: Everything · IBM Plex Mono 400/600; headers tracked +0.2em

motion: Lines print at ~110ms intervals, each dropping 6px into place (print-head rhythm).
The roll grows downwards; the page scroll follows it.
Idea: a "Tear off" button that animates a rip and copies the content.
watchouts: Keep the column narrow (≈ 32–42 characters) or it stops reading as a receipt.
Item/price rows must stay real text, not ASCII art, for screen readers.
Faded grey thermal ink fails contrast. Keep the ink near #2A2A2A.
